caseStudies.title: Real-time monitoring for mission-critical apps
caseStudies.problem: Latency problems in critical enterprise applications were found late, after users felt them.
caseStudies.built: A real-time Microsoft Fabric platform (Event Streams, Data Factory, OneLake, Direct Lake) with intelligent alerting and anomaly detection.

result.label: saved a year, with issues resolved 80% faster

caseStudies.title: One data platform from two client environments
caseStudies.problem: A client's data lived in two separate environments, so every report meant stitching them together by hand.
caseStudies.built: An end-to-end Microsoft Fabric platform: ingestion frameworks, ETL, monitored pipelines with failure detection and fallbacks, and a Fabric Data Agent that answers business questions in plain language.

result.label: hours of manual work saved a month

caseStudies.title: Secured finance dashboards
caseStudies.problem: Finance and operations teams built EBITDA, AR ageing and performance reports manually.
caseStudies.built: Power BI and Tableau dashboards on the Fabric platform, with row-, column- and object-level security, performance tuning and automated refresh.

caseStudies.title: Workforce forecasting in production
caseStudies.problem: Workforce planning relied on manual forecasts that missed demand swings.
caseStudies.built: PyTorch, TensorFlow and Greykite forecasting models wired into automated decision-support pipelines on Microsoft Fabric.

caseStudies.title: Transaction fraud detection
caseStudies.problem: Fraud was caught too late, after losses had already happened.
caseStudies.built: Fraud detection models in Python and Spark running on transaction data.
